ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_sp_d2_finale_: All of Bikini Bottom is walking around with a bucket on its head. Blow them off with your bubble blaster and walk your parade to the Bubble Bowl.
Climb onto the stage of the Bubble Bowl and rock so hard that every bucket flies off. King Neptuguh gets his crown, Mr. Krabguh thaws, and Spongeguh... becomes manager!
The crown is back, but the bubble sun is about to set! Princess Mindy Guh calls a very big friend on Shell City's pier.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.beloning: Spongeguh part 2 is done! You got: Spongeguh as your buddy, Gary the snail, Plankmika's antennas for your guhs and the title Guhfy Guhber. From now on Mr. Krabguh sells you Nibble Patties for cheese nibbles.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.beloning.al: Spongeguh and Gary will come and visit you, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.hint.bellen: Everyone is free! Walk to the Bubble Bowl, %s: up Bubble Lane to the north.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.hint.emmers: Behind the town gate, Bikini Bottom guhs are walking around with a bucket on their head, %s. Go to the golden columns of light and blow the buckets off with your bubble blaster (right-click).
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.hint.pier: The crown has to go home, and fast! Walk to the head of the long pier, %s: east past the beach, out into the void. Princess Mindy Guh is already waving there.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.hint.podium: Plankmika is standing on the stage of the Bubble Bowl, %s. Climb onto the stage by the little steps at the front left or right.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.klik.bewone: Psst. I'm hiding behind my mailbox. Someone is walking around here with buckets!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.klik.emmer: Plankmika... is... the... boss... (the bucket echoes a little)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.klik.patguh: I'm just following you. That's my plan. It has been my whole life.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.klik.plankm: Any moment now, I'll be king of Bikini Bottom! Mwahaha! ...Why are you looking at me like that?
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.klik.sponsg: What an adventure! Any moment now I'll be totally unspongeably excited, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.klik.vrij: I'm coming with you to the Bubble Bowl!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.bikinibo: I still can't believe I had a bucket on. I can still feel a rim on my ears.
That concert! I sang 'Guhfy Guhber' all night long. So did my neighbours. Not by choice.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.cycloop_: My shop only sells wet souvenirs now. They'll dry. Someday.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.david_ha: Another ride? I'm always swimming somewhere anyway. I'll just keep training, watch.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.juf_pufg: I heard you rode a giant guh. Without a licence! I'm puffing up just thinking about it.
<Mr. Krabguh> Three cheese nibbles, lad. Not two. Not two and a half. Three.
<Mr. Krabguh> One Nibble Patty, fresh off the grill. The secret ingredient stays secret, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.loopgraa: Rrrraaah! ...Sorry, force of habit. How did that song go again? La la laaa.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.meneer_k: Ah, the hero of the crown! A Nibble Patty? Hold cheese nibbles in your paw and click me: three nibbles a patty. No haggling.
I've never had such a cold day in my life. Brrr. I sleep under three blankets now.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.octo_mik: It was so nice and quiet under that bucket. Nobody talking to me.
That concert? I didn't hear it. I can't hear anything. La la la.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.octoliam: Hmph. Rocking. Anyone can do that. I could do it too. If I wanted to.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.parel_gu: Daddy says you thawed him out. I say I'm knitting him a scarf now!
Those bucket helmets were SO not in fashion.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.patguh.1: I'm the official best customer now. I've got a card. It's a bit of cardboard.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.patguh.2: I'm still practising on the guitar. It's still made of cardboard.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.plankmik: I wasn't in a bucket. YOU were in a bucket! ...Wait, that's not right either.
Plans A to Z are used up. Tomorrow I start on Plan Ä.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.na.sponsguh: Being manager is amazing! I've held seven meetings already. With myself.
Coming to flip a patty later? The grill misses you, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.1: <David Hasselguh> Everyone comfy? Don't pull my back hair, I just combed it.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.2: <Patguh> Look! Down there! Our houses are so tiny! ...Oh no, that's a crumb.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.3: <Spongeguh> Hang in there, Mr. Krabguh! We're coming with your crown and your ice-free future!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.4: <David Hasselguh> I'll drop you off at the jetty in front of the town gate. You'll have to run the last bit yourselves. I'm tired from all this being handsome.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.blijf: Stay seated, nyeg: David Hasselguh is swimming you home.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.mislukt: David Hasselguh can't carry you right now. Stand on the head of the pier again.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.op: David Hasselguh dives under the pier. Hop, onto his back!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.rit.weer: <David Hasselguh> There you are again! Climb on, I'm still swimming that way.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.spel.blazer: Spongeguh pushes a bubble blaster into your paws: "Aim at the bucket and blow away!" (right-click)
Patguh found your bubble blaster in a puddle of sauce. Here you go, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.spel.mis: Missed! Come a bit closer and aim at the bucket.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.spel.naar_b: Off to the Bubble Bowl, in the north
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.spel.regel: Blow the buckets off %s guhs with your bubble blaster
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.vrij.1: <Bikini Bottom Guh> Huh? Where am I? Why do I smell of bucket?
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.vrij.2: <Bikini Bottom Guh> All this time all I could see was my own nose. Thanks, nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.vrij.3: <Bikini Bottom Guh> I had to keep saying 'Plankmika is the boss'. I thought it was a silly song.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.vrij.4: <Bikini Bottom Guh> My ears! My ears are still there! Wahoog!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.vrij.5: <Bikini Bottom Guh> Finally! I really need to pee. ...After the concert.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale.vrij.6: <Bikini Bottom Guh> I'm coming with you! I can cheer really loudly, listen: WOOOOH!
gui.guhs.titels.hint.guhfy_guhber: Rock so hard that the buckets fly off (Spongeguh part 2).
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.9: To the head of the pier
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.10: Bikini Bottom is wearing Plankmika's bucket helmets! Walk through the town gate onto the High Street and use your bubble blaster (right-click) to blow the buckets off the six Bikini Bottom guhs under the golden columns of light. Then on to the Bubble Bowl in the north.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.10_b: Everyone is free! Walk your whole parade up Bubble Lane to the north, into the Bubble Bowl: the big oval stadium.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.11: Plankmika is standing on the stage of the Bubble Bowl, about to crown himself. Climb onto the stage by the little steps at the front left or right: time for the loudest song Bikini Bottom has ever heard.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.9: Bring the crown home! Walk out of the gift shop, across the square to the beach, and onto the long pier that runs east into the void. Princess Mindy Guh is waiting at the head of the pier.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.klaa: The crown is back, Mr. Krabguh has thawed and Spongeguh is manager. And Spongeguh and Gary sort of live with you now. Wahoog!

scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_bedankt.c: You were the best co-worker, driving buddy, bucket blower and drummer I've ever had.

scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_bedankt.l: On my days off I'll come and stay with you. I'll bring my own spatula!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_bedankt.s: Et voilà, nyeg: Bikini Bottom got its crown back, Mr. Krabguh got his warmth back, and you got two new housemates.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d2_finale_bedankt.w: I'm coming too! ...Where do you live, actually?

Wonderful. Now he's got a hat as well. Could somebody give me my bucket back?

...Have you still got your drum? Patguh, grab a guitar! It's made of cardboard, but that doesn't matter!
ME?! MANAGER?! I'm going to faint. No, I'm not going to faint. I'm going to CHEER!
And I'll be the customer! The very best customer!
My crown! But... who stole it, then, if it wasn't poor Krabguh?
Spongeguh, lad... you saved everything. You're the manager of the new Krusty Nibble!
